digest.component_or_area: CLI mutating verbs output and confirmation
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs currently exit silently on success, making idempotent no-ops indistinguishable from successful writes, causing agents to run redundant verification queries and misinterpret outcomes

Every mutating verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must print a uniform confirmation line on stdout upon successful write or no-op, using a past-tense verb format (e.g., 'linked <src> -> <target>', 'no change: already linked ...')

The --quiet and --output flags must be extracted once at the top-level CLI router before any verb dispatch, enabling all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves to support consistent global output control
Confirmations must print only in text mode; under --output json the outcome rides as a structured field in a uniform envelope with fields like outcome, subject, and detail
Consumed seam return values like add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT contract must remain unchanged; the CLI derives confirmation from existing seam signals without altering their type or meaning
The link verb's REDIRECT record must remain byte-identical before and after changes, with --quiet never suppressing the record (quiet governs only confirmation text lines, not machine data)
